nodes.label: ReviewTimeline
nodes.rationale: Handles handlebar and export-start/export-end draggable elements with a single set of shared drag handlers. Comment in source notes the onHandlebarDraggingChange callback prop name is retained for backward compatibility but is now treated as a generic 'isDragging' signal so consumers (export-handle timelines) can enable preview scrubbing while dragging export handles, not just the review handlebar. A no-recording tooltip for the handlebar is implemented but explicitly disabled via a hardcoded `false &&` with a TODO comment questioning whether to keep it.
